purpose: Inspect modeled charging power versus SOC, compare returned charging sessions, and review charger, monthly speed and DC time-to-charge statistics.
primaryGoal: Use the workspace vehicle and range to inspect a session and compare charging behavior without confusing modeled curves, incomplete readings or bounded history with measured full-history telemetry.

dataSources.behavior: Enabled only when vehicleId is not null; key includes vehicle, both bounds, limit and offset; AbortSignal forwarded; STALE_TIMES.FAST and safeArray retained. This page requests one 200-session window, not an exhaustive aggregate.
dataSources.units: SI API fields include peak_power_w, avg_power_w and total_energy_added_wh; local chart view models explicitly contain display kW, kWh and minutes.
dataSources.backendLimits: Route registration verified; handler filtering, inclusive/exclusive bound interpretation, order and actual server cap were not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.behavior: No competing local vehicle/date selector. Both aliases are range-enabled at workspaceScope.ts:30,33. Page consumes calendar start/end rather than provided precise instants. Session selection resets when vehicle or calendar bounds change.

dataSources.owner: Existing opt-in AI feature and streaming infrastructure
dataSources.behavior: Positive finite vehicle ID required; vehicle_id body; scopeKey cancels/clears on vehicle change; independent feature toggle. No page range supplied.
dataSources.backendLimits: Endpoint observed in consumer source; corresponding AI route registration and backend scope were not traced.

dataSources.owner: Existing opt-in ML feature and streaming infrastructure
dataSources.behavior: User-initiated Train action, vehicle_id and fixed lookback_days=90; scopeKey follows vehicle; independent feature toggle. This is not the workspace range.
dataSources.backendLimits: Endpoint and request body source-confirmed only; no mutation executed and route registration not traced.

dataSources.owner: Existing settings, formatting and metric presentation infrastructure
dataSources.behavior: Preserve saved locale, precision, currency and chart_palette; palette supports cb_safe default and explicit neon opt-in. Settings endpoint not independently traced.

components.contract: Existing category exports. CardGrid items carry stable id, size and content; container measurement owns packing. Preserve w-full/min-w-0, shared header and allocated width.

components.name: Select, Caption, HelperText, TimeStamp
components.contract: Native controlled Select with label/options/value/onChange/placeholder/disabled; existing focus and feedback wiring. Page min-h-11 provides 44px minimum height. TimeStamp retains source start timestamp.

components.name: useDataState, StaleRefreshWarning, CurveSourceSection
components.contract: state, vehicleSelected, hasSessions, height, onResetRange, onRetry, selectionRequired and children. Fatal errors, initial skeletons, missing vehicle, blocked connection, empty and selected-session states keep section shells; retained content is not replaced.

components.name: CurveSummary / ChargingSummaryBrief / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Typed StatMetric inputs, period, loading, retained, missing context and specialist display formatter. Six summary metrics and four DC metrics retain identities and bounded-history scope.

components.name: ChartContainer
components.contract: title/subtitle/ariaLabel/ariaDescription, data/dataColumns/exportData/exportFilename, metadata, chartKey, size/mobileHeight, loading/error/empty and capability controls. Five mounted chart sites already supply accessible data and exports.

components.name: SessionDetailPanel / GlassPanel / KVList
components.contract: Named region and generated heading identity; six base detail fields and conditional average power, cost and place. Keep all existing optional detail fields.

components.name: AIChargingCurveFingerprintClustering / AIMLChargingCurveClustering
components.contract: Existing withAiFeature gates and AIFeatureCard/stream behavior; preserve Explain/Train, scope cancellation and independent toggles. AI-off must not suppress baseline sections.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-012/MDC-034: repeated non-token axis label styling
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Seven axis labels across four chart consumers repeat white-alpha fill and fontSize 11 despite existing token-backed axisTick/axisTickSm.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consume one chart-owner label style from the existing chart utility/category export, preserving each localized label, angle and position.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The barrel still exposes the old six-color MetricCard summary while the mounted page uses CurveSummary and ChargingSummaryBrief.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep the mounted canonical summary; resolve remaining old-summary consumers before any cleanup. Do not re-adopt the older zero-default renderer.

sourceEvidence: ChargingCurvePage.tsx:176-180 stacks selector/context by default and reflows at sm with min-w-0 and break-words.
CardGrid.tsx:26-38 measures allocated container width and provides placement context rather than relying only on viewport breakpoints.
Charts use ResponsiveContainer width=100%, with explicit 280/300/320px inner heights.

issues.detail: Charger footer pairs label and count/duration in a no-wrap flex row without min-w-0, gap or text-breaking strategy; long localized labels may overflow. Source risk, not observed overflow.
issues.fix: Allow footer wrapping or narrow-width stacking with semantic Text roles; retain label, count and average duration.

sourceEvidence: Five named page sections; native labeled Select; decorative icons hidden in detail/DC metric contexts.
Five ChartContainer sites supply ariaLabel, data and dataColumns; detail panel supplies role=region and aria-labelledby.

issues.rule: MDC-042: reduced-motion must cover bar series
issues.detail: Both charger bars lack AREA_DEFAULTS or chartAnimationProps; YearlyTrendChart.tsx:92 count bar has the same omission. Shared chartDefaults explicitly supplies motion-aware props for bars.
issues.fix: Apply existing chartAnimationProps to all three bars; keep line defaults, data, series and user preferences unchanged.

accessibility.limits: Keyboard, focus order/restoration, screen reader output, actual contrast, touch target spacing, reduced-motion rendering and forced-colors mode were not exercised.

states.initialLoading: Per-source Skeleton through CurveSourceSection.tsx:42-48; summary loading via CurveSummary; PageLayout busy retains page composition.
states.noVehicle: Disabled session selector and choose-workspace-vehicle message in each source shell.
states.empty: Resolved empty session results retain shells and offer workspace range reset; summary distinguishes missing measurements from count zero.
states.fatalError: QueryError with retry in each source shell and summary.
states.refreshError: Retained sessions and selection stay visible; shared warning adjacent to content.
states.partial: Availability counts energy, power, cost, SOC and positive duration; explicit partial message warns about unchanged zero-contributing calculations.
states.offline: No-data blocked connection message and retained-data shared warning.
states.selectedSession: Explicit selection required for curve and detail only; other analyses remain independent.

issues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045: unknown is not a measured zero
issues.detail: Missing energy and peak power become 0 kWh/0 kW in selected-session details. CurveSummary separately marks all-missing input unavailable, so trust differs within the same page.
issues.fix: Show unavailable placeholders for missing detail values; retain actual numeric zero and the unchanged legacy aggregate calculation/disclosure. Coordinate any calculation change separately.

issues.rule: MDC-026: unobserved threshold duration is not zero
issues.detail: avg([]) returns zero in yearly threshold buckets, although headline DC threshold metrics correctly use null. SpeedTrendChart.tsx:50-51 also assigns zero to a missing AC/DC monthly category.
issues.fix: Disclose no qualifying observations and distinguish gaps in a coordinated typed data-contract change; preserve all buckets/counts/exports and do not silently change statistical denominators.

visualIssues.detail: SessionCurveChart:87,96; SessionComparisonChart:88,97; SpeedTrendChart:107; YearlyTrendChart:76,87 use rgba(255,255,255,0.4). This bypasses semantic label tokens and is a light-theme contrast risk, not measured contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing chart token family for subdued but legible axis-label text; keep meaningful primary series emphasis and all axis descriptions.

visualIssues.detail: CHARGER_COLORS has Supercharger but not helper labels Home / AC or DC Fast. Those categories fall back to CHART_COLORS[3]/[4], so the footer and power bar use yellow while energy uses sky blue for the same category.
visualIssues.fix: Resolve stable charger category identities through the existing color owner, with restrained semantic colors; retain distinct power/energy axes and opacity encoding. Do not key color meaning on translated text or reset explicit chart palette preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: Page destructures start/end and passes those dates at line 49 rather than startInstant/endInstantExclusive. useRangeState.ts:656-682 provides timezone-aware calendar bounds and precise rolling Live/24h instants. Rolling passage within a calendar day does not update this page's query bounds.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the integration owner confirm backend bound support, then use precise shared instants through the existing hook; update selection invalidation deliberately so rolling refresh does not unnecessarily unset a valid inspector. Preserve URL/shared preferences and full-server filtering.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-002: feature callers use category barrels
architectureIssues.detail: CurveSummary deep-imports LayoutCard and StatMetric from reference owners. CurveSourceSection.tsx:5 similarly deep-imports layout-reference for LayoutCard/useCardPlacement.
architectureIssues.fix: Use category exports for LayoutCard/StatMetric; ask the layout owner to expose the existing useCardPlacement if needed, not a competing context or wrapper.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-044: localize presentation without changing source identities
architectureIssues.detail: getChargerLabel returns untranslated Home / AC, Supercharger and DC Fast. These labels feed selector, details, grouping, colors and exports; changing them directly would also change category identities.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep stable category identifiers/calculations, add localized presentation at boundaries using canonical catalogs through the integration owner, and preserve grouping and exported schema.

architectureIssues.detail: ML training uses a fixed 90-day request while baseline charts use the workspace range and up to 200 rows. AI descriptions refer to baseline parity without exposing these independent windows beside the actions.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain current requests/gates; disclose the 90-day ML window and independently known explanation scope, avoiding claims of range equivalence. Do not alter AI model requests as a cosmetic modernization.

priority.reason: Existing page already adopts shared layout and trust shells. Prioritize workspace instant mismatch and unknown-versus-zero truthfulness, then motion, label tokens, palette/category identity and source-scope clarity; no page rewrite needed.

competingImplementations.name: SummaryStatsGrid versus CurveSummary
competingImplementations.detail: Old summary remains exported; root imports CurveSummary instead. Existence is source-confirmed, remaining production consumers are not traced.
competingImplementations.decision: Keep the current OperationalBrief-backed summary and do not infer safe deletion.
